blocks.text: Puzzles

blocks.html: The location of the puzzle rooms are constant, but the puzzles themselves are different for each player.

blocks.text: Rotation puzzles

blocks.caption: An example rotation puzzle, with the Solution panel visible

blocks.html: If you get a rotation puzzle, then you need to:
Click the Solution panel to view the Clue
blocks.text: Click the Solution panel to view the Clue

blocks.html: Use the table below to find the Solution
blocks.text: Use the table below to find the Solution

blocks.html: Rotate the Shadow casters till they match the solution.
blocks.text: Rotate the Shadow casters till they match the solution.

blocks.label: Clue · Solution
head: Clue
Solution
rows: All four casters need sad faces
You and I are beautifully broken. The others resent our superiority
Sad faces on the south casters and broken faces on the north casters.
When the sun rises, we are happy. When the sun sets, we are sad.
Happy faces on both of the east casters, sad faces on the west casters.
I'm bored of helping you, you can figure this one out on your own
North-west: Neutral - north-east: Happy - south-east: Sad - south-west: Broken
I'm not a morning person; nor am I a mourning person
Sad faces on the eastern wall, leave the western two without masks.
Never let anyone see how you truly feel, they will use it against you
All neutral expressions on all four casters

blocks.text: Projection puzzles

blocks.caption: An unsolved version of a projection puzzle.
The solved version of a projection puzzle.

blocks.html: If you get a projection puzzle (one large Sliske face on the floor), then you need to:
Kill any wights in the room to obtain missing Masks (they will drop a Mask of Glee, Mask of Sorrow or Mask of Indifference)
blocks.text: Kill any wights in the room to obtain missing Masks (they will drop a Mask of Glee, Mask of Sorrow or Mask of Indifference)

blocks.html: Click the Viewing panel to begin the projection mode
blocks.text: Click the Viewing panel to begin the projection mode

blocks.html: If it says one of the projectors are damaged, repair them
blocks.text: If it says one of the projectors are damaged, repair them

blocks.html: Rotate the Shadow casters till it forms the solution image shown on the right (a complete Sliske mask)
blocks.text: Rotate the Shadow casters till it forms the solution image shown on the right (a complete Sliske mask)
Mask replacement puzzles

blocks.html: If you get a room with shadow casters and the command Take Mask is visible when you rollover a caster, then you need to do the below steps.
If you drop items from your inventory to make room for the masks, they will be permanently lost upon completion of the puzzle if they are still on the ground.
Click the solution panel to view the Clue, then view the Solution from the table in the section above
blocks.text: Click the solution panel to view the Clue, then view the Solution from the table in the section above

blocks.html: Kill any wights in the room to obtain missing Masks (they will drop a Mask of Glee, Mask of Sorrow or Mask of Indifference)
blocks.text: Kill any wights in the room to obtain missing Masks (they will drop a Mask of Glee, Mask of Sorrow or Mask of Indifference)

blocks.html: Take the mask from all the casters that don't match the description, and re-attach the mask on another caster till it matches
blocks.text: Take the mask from all the casters that don't match the description, and re-attach the mask on another caster till it matches

blocks.html: When all the casters are matching the solution, the puzzle will be solved
blocks.text: When all the casters are matching the solution, the puzzle will be solved

blocks.html: There is a teleblock in place; however, you can leave the arena by using the portal's right-click option. You can have a familiar for the fight.
Use the purple exit portal to leave, and prepare for a tough fight with the best combat gear you have.

blocks.html: The fight is divided into 3 phases, at the end of each phase you can bank and return to resume from that checkpoint

Phase 1

blocks.html: Fight against wights of increasing difficulty, kill enough of them to increase the progress bar on top.
blocks.text: Fight against wights of increasing difficulty, kill enough of them to increase the progress bar on top.

substeps.html: Use Deflect Melee or Deflect Ranged depending on the types of wights you are fighting
substeps.text: Use Deflect Melee or Deflect Ranged depending on the types of wights you are fighting

substeps.html: Be aware that all remaining unstable wight footsoldiers will explode at the end of the wave, potentially causing death if the player is surrounded but you will continue onto the next wave when you return.
substeps.text: Be aware that all remaining unstable wight footsoldiers will explode at the end of the wave, potentially causing death if the player is surrounded but you will continue onto the next wave when you return.

blocks.text: Phase 2

blocks.html: This part of the fight can be extremely difficult. It is highly recommended to stand between the middle and western rifts at all times, beginning while Sliske is talking. This prevents Linza from attacking throughout the fight.
Kill Nomad.
blocks.text: Kill Nomad.

substeps.html: Use Deflect Ranged while fighting him.
substeps.text: Use Deflect Ranged while fighting him.

substeps.html: Nomad plants mines and Gregorovic rains damage on the arena. Make sure to walk off of marked tiles.
substeps.text: Nomad plants mines and Gregorovic rains damage on the arena. Make sure to walk off of marked tiles.

blocks.html: Kill Linza the Disgraced.
blocks.text: Kill Linza the Disgraced.

substeps.html: Use Deflect Melee while fighting her.
substeps.text: Use Deflect Melee while fighting her.

substeps.html: Linza reflects damage which is less deadly after she's the only surviving boss.
substeps.text: Linza reflects damage which is less deadly after she's the only surviving boss.

substeps.html: She also has a blue charged bar that appears above her head and does a very high damage move. She will also bind before she does this move so have surge or freedom ready. It is recommended to dodge this attack.
substeps.text: She also has a blue charged bar that appears above her head and does a very high damage move. She will also bind before she does this move so have surge or freedom ready. It is recommended to dodge this attack.

blocks.html: Kill Gregorovic.
blocks.text: Kill Gregorovic.

substeps.html: Use Deflect Ranged while fighting him.
substeps.text: Use Deflect Ranged while fighting him.

substeps.html: The spirits that spawn towards Gregorovic will heal him if they reach him. Kill them before they touch him.
substeps.text: The spirits that spawn towards Gregorovic will heal him if they reach him. Kill them before they touch him.

blocks.text: Phase 3

blocks.html: Kill Sliske. You cannot use deathtouched darts to kill Sliske.
blocks.text: Kill Sliske. You cannot use deathtouched darts to kill Sliske.

substeps.html: Use Deflect Magic throughout the fight as the majority of the damage will be magic classed. Keep in mind that prayer points are drained faster than normal in this fight.
substeps.text: Use Deflect Magic throughout the fight as the majority of the damage will be magic classed. Keep in mind that prayer points are drained faster than normal in this fight.

substeps.html: If you are having trouble, wearing the Armour of Trials and wielding Vanquish can help greatly has it can provide a 25% defensive and offensive bonus during the fight if you die 5 times in a row.
substeps.text: If you are having trouble, wearing the Armour of Trials and wielding Vanquish can help greatly has it can provide a 25% defensive and offensive bonus during the fight if you die 5 times in a row.

substeps.html: Beware of his special attack where several shadow pits will appear below your feet. Step away to avoid significant damage. He will summon 4 shadow pits in the first round, 5 in the second, and 4 in the subsequent two rounds. On rounds 3 and 4, Sliske's attacks will predict where you are walking towards on the 4th and final shadow pit.

substeps.text: Destroy the Power Source in the centre of the room.

substeps.html: Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.
substeps.text: Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.

substeps.html: Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.
substeps.text: Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.

substeps.text: Jump on the rock formation in front of Sliske.

substeps.html: Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.
substeps.text: Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.

subs: A hunter's Catalyst fragment, which resets several hunter traps if they fail to catch any prey.
A runecrafter's Catalyst fragment, which halves the degradation rate of runecrafting pouches.
A farmer's Catalyst fragment, which allows the player to cure diseased herbs for free while also providing Farming experience and Herblore experience in the form of shadow-infused herbs.
The Ring of Whispers that gives a bonus to gathering skills.
The Necklace of Shadows that stops familiars draining Summoning points after they have initially been summoned.
A set effect of a manifested knowledge randomly spawning and providing bonus experience when all three items (after combining the Catalyst fragments into the combined Catalyst fragment) are worn.
